items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: And he had Lawrence Brown on tenor

ctx.x: Well, Al Wynn was one. I was one. Francois and Duke El, Duke Caston. I mean, his name is Charles Duke Caston, but we called him Duke. And he had Lawrence Brown on tenor, Robert Crowder on tenor, Fred Howard on alto and clarinet. And he had Clowns, Clowns Brown on piano. He had me, I'm trying to think of these trumpet players now. I forget that boy's name. But I mean, I mean anyhow, well, Hopkin went off with us. Hopkin and me and another little young trumpet, he's younger than us, but he could play a lot and he…
You named the tuba player or bass player?
